Confidential string values are replaced by empty strings or public-safe placeholders; confidential list items are recursively sanitized in place. No raw model output, prompt, reasoning excerpt, tool argument, response-bearing detail, private endpoint, operator path, host identity, GPU UUID, container name, or raw container ID is published.
